mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lambda_errors (lambda_version_id, code_upload_date, error_signature, error_text, error_message, error_count, error_date) VALUES (#{lambdaVersionId}, #{functionStartDate}, #{errorSignature}, #{errorText}, #{errorMessage}, 1, #{date})

INSERT INTO lambda_latest_runs SET lambda_assignment_id = #{lambdaAssignmentId}, invocation_lane = #{invocationLane}, lambda_version_id = #{lambdaVersionId}, function_name = #{functionName}, trigger_count = #{triggerCount}, pending_count = #{pendingCount}, next_input_number = #{nextInputNumber}, run_id = #{runId}, prev_run_id = #{prevRunId}, invocation_gen = #{invocationGen}, is_started = #{started}, aws_request_id = #{awsRequestId}, aws_log_stream = #{awsLogStream}, triggered_at = #{triggeredAt}, expiry_date = #{expiryDate}, aws_log_end_date = #{awsLogEndDate}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM lambda_run_results s JOIN lambda_assignments i ON i.lambda_assignment_id = s.lambda_assignment_id JOIN lambda_active_versions v ON v.lambda_version_id = s.lambda_version_id

SELECT s.lambda_assignment_id, s.result_code, s.lane, s.triggers, s.request_date, s.execution_time, s.memory, s.event_date, s.server, s.retries, s.result_message AS "resultMessageCompressed", i.location_id, v.function_start_date, CASE s.lane WHEN 'ASYNC' THEN v.async_function_name ELSE v.function_name END AS "function_name" FROM lambda_run_results s JOIN lambda_assignments i ON i.lambda_assignment_id = s.lambda_assignment_id JOIN lambda_active_versions v ON v.lambda_version_id = s.lambda_version_id

SELECT lambda_version_id, SUM(request_count) AS total_executions, SUM(request_count * execution_time) AS total_execution_time, SUM(CASE result_code WHEN 0 THEN request_count ELSE 0 END) AS successful_executions FROM lambda_run_stat_day WHERE lambda_version_id IN ( #{lambdaVersionId} ) GROUP BY 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lambda_run_stat_day ( lambda_version_id, lane, result_code, request_date, request_count, assignment_count, execution_time, min_execution_time, max_execution_time) (SELECT lambda_version_id, lane, result_code, #{startDate}, COUNT(1), COUNT(DISTINCT lambda_assignment_id), AVG(execution_time), MIN(execution_time), MAX(execution_time) FROM lambda_run_results WHERE part = #{part} AND request_date >= #{startDate} AND request_date < #{endDate} GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4)
mapper.select: WITH stat AS ( SELECT lambda_version_id, lane, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT function_name, ',') AS functionNames, AVG(memory) AS memory FROM lambda_run_results WHERE part = #{part} AND request_date >= #{startDate} AND request_date < #{endDate} AND lane IN ('DEFAULT','ASYNC') AND function_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT #{startDate} AS startDate, s.lambda_version_id, s.lane, h.lambda_id, s.functionNames, s.memory FROM stat s, lambda_versions h WHERE h.lambda_version_id = s.lambda_version_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lambda_daily_metrics ( lambda_version_id, start_date, lambda_id, lane, invocations, throttles, errors, dead_letter_errors, avg_concurrent_executions, max_concurrent_executions, async_events_received, async_events_dropped, async_event_age, max_async_event_age, total_duration, gb_s_billed) VALUES ( #{lambdaVersionId}, #{startDate}, #{lambdaId}, #{lane}, #{invocations}, #{throttles}, #{errors}, #{deadLetterErrors}, #{avgConcurrentExecutions}, #{maxConcurrentExecutions}, #{asyncEventsReceived}, #{asyncEventsDropped}, #{asyncEventAge}, #{maxAsyncEventAge}, #{totalDuration}, #{gbSBilled})
mapper.select: SELECT lambda_version_id, start_date, lambda_id, lane, invocations, throttles, errors, dead_letter_errors, avg_concurrent_executions, max_concurrent_executions, async_events_received, async_events_dropped, async_event_age, max_async_event_age, total_duration, gb_s_billed FROM lambda_daily_metrics WHERE lambda_id = #{lambdaId} AND start_date = #{startDate}
